text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 88, January 23, 1937 ]
PRESCRIBING REGULATIONS GOVERNING THE RECEIPT AND ACCEPTANCE OF DONATIONS
OF MONEY FOR THE NATIONAL DEFENSE AND THE EXPENDITURE THEREOF
By virtue of the provisions of Commonwealth Act Numbered Thirty-three authorizing the President to receive
and accept donations of money not subject to onerous condition, made for the purpose of the National Defense
or support of the Philippine Army, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the Philippines, do hereby
promulgate the following regulations governing the receipt and acceptance of such donations of money and
the expenditure thereof, for the information and guidance of all concerned:
1. All cashiers or collecting officers of the different Departments, Bureaus, and offices of the National
Government, the Chief of Staff, the Deputy and Assistant Chief of Staff, the Provost Marshall General,
Quartermasters, the Provincial Military Commanders, Philippine Army, including provincial, city, or
municipal treasurers, are authorized to received and accept donations of money for the national defense
issuing therefore the regular official receipts.
2. All donation collections shall, immediately at the end of the month, be remitted to the Office of the
President by treasury warrant, check, or money order accompanied by abstract, showing (1) date, (2) number
of official receipt, (3) name of donor, (4) amount, and (5) purpose of donation, whether general or specific.
3. In the case, however, of organized campaign under special authority granted any government entity to
solicit and receive voluntary contributions for donations by the entity concerned to the National Defense in
cash or in the purchase of some particular implement of war for the use of the Philippine Army, the
contributions received need not be remitted as required in paragraph two thereof, but the same may be
retained and kept in deposit in the treasury of the respective entity, until the amount or quota needed is
covered up when the remittance may be made to the Office of the President.
4. The donations of money so far received and those to be hereafter received shall be accounted for as a
special fund which is hereby created to be known as National Defense Fund.
5. The release and expenditure of the National Defense Fund shall be made for such purpose of national
defense or support of the Philippine Army as may be recommended by the Chief of Staff and approved by the
President: Provided, that donations made for a specific purpose shall be expended or used only for that
6. Certificate of donation shall be issued by the Office of the President to any person, corporation, company,
or association making donation of money in the sum of one peso or more for specific purpose, or otherwise
besides the regular official receipt already issued.
Done at the City of Manila, this twenty-third day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-seven, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the second.
(Sgd.) MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(Sgd.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
Secretary of the Interior
